title: Failed Delivery Attempts and Orders Returned to the Store (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
A failed delivery attempt on a Delivery & Pickup Services order is recorded with its reason and its attempt number. The reasons recorded are: no one available to sign, address not found, building access, weather or road closure, and no ID presented.

## When an order goes back to the store

An order is returned to the fulfilling store:

- after the plan's number of delivery attempts have failed, the failed attempts being counted across the order and the redelivery orders that replace it; or
- when no redelivery is scheduled within the plan's redelivery window days of the last failed attempt.

An order is returned at most once: an order already recorded as returned to the store, or as delivered, is not returned again.

## After the return

A returned order waits at the store for pickup for the plan's hold days from the return date. Its prescriptions are returned to stock no earlier than the later of that day and the end of their will-call hold under the Prescriptions charter. A temperature-controlled item is never redelivered after being returned.

## Counting attempts across redeliveries (hypothetical, plan allowing 2 attempts)

| Record | Failed attempts counted for the order |
|---|---|
| Original order, attempt 1 fails (no one available to sign) | 1 |
| Redelivery naming the original order, its attempt fails (building access) | 2, so the order is returned to the store |

On a plan allowing 3 attempts (Kestrel Mail Delivery, Kestrel Specialty Courier Service) the same two failures leave one further attempt.

## Hypothetical hold

On a plan with a 7-day hold, an order returned on 4 April waits for pickup until 11 April; if its prescriptions' will-call hold under the Prescriptions charter ends on 14 April, they are returned to stock no earlier than 14 April, the later of the two days.
